name: Lisbon
description: Hilly coastal capital known for trams, pastel tiles, custard tarts and lively fado nights.

name: Kyoto
description: Former imperial capital with thousands of temples, tea houses and famous cherry blossom and autumn foliage seasons.

name: Marrakech
description: Walled city of bustling souks, riads and the Jemaa el-Fnaa square, with the Atlas Mountains nearby.

name: Banff
description: Rocky Mountain town surrounded by turquoise lakes, glaciers and trails; popular for hiking in summer and skiing in winter.

name: Cusco
description: Former Inca capital high in the Andes and the usual base for treks to Machu Picchu.

name: Queenstown
description: Adventure hub on a mountain-ringed lake, known for bungee jumping, skiing and the surrounding Fiordland scenery.

name: Istanbul
description: City spanning two continents with the Hagia Sophia, bazaars, ferries on the Bosphorus and rich cuisine.

name: Petra
description: Ancient rock-carved city of the Nabataeans reached through a narrow canyon, surrounded by desert landscapes.

name: Reykjavik
best_season: June to August; winter for aurora
description: Small capital used as a base for geysers, waterfalls, geothermal pools and northern lights viewing.

name: Ubud
description: Cultural heart of Bali with rice terraces, temples, art markets and many yoga and wellness retreats.

name: Cape Town
description: Coastal city beneath Table Mountain with beaches, nearby vineyards and penguin colonies.

name: Rome
description: Capital full of ancient ruins, Renaissance art and trattorias, from the Colosseum to the Vatican.

name: Hanoi
description: Busy capital with an old quarter of narrow streets, street food, lakes and French colonial buildings.

name: Torres del Paine
description: Patagonian national park of granite towers, glaciers and lakes, famous for multi-day trekking circuits.

name: Mexico City
description: Huge high-altitude capital known for tacos, world-class museums, Aztec ruins and colourful neighbourhoods.

name: Santorini
description: Volcanic island with whitewashed villages on caldera cliffs, black-sand beaches and famous sunsets.

name: Chiang Mai
description: Northern city with hundreds of temples, night markets, cooking classes and ethical elephant sanctuaries.

name: Zanzibar
description: Spice island with white-sand beaches, a historic stone town and good diving and snorkelling.

name: Sydney
description: Harbour city with the Opera House, coastal walks, surf beaches and a diverse food scene.

name: Dubai
description: Futuristic city of record-breaking towers, huge malls, beach resorts and desert safaris.

name: Rio de Janeiro
description: Beach city under Sugarloaf and Christ the Redeemer, with samba, hiking in rainforest and lively nightlife.

name: Hoi An
description: Lantern-lit old trading town with tailors, cooking classes and nearby beaches.

name: Prague
description: Fairy-tale old town with a medieval castle, Gothic spires, stone bridges and a strong beer culture.

name: Serengeti
description: Vast savanna famous for the great wildebeest migration and for lions, elephants and other big game.
